Name: Bats and Mushrooms Farm Cave by aedenthorn (Unofficial 1.6 Update)
Author: KronosTitanAnthem
Description:
The original mod is compatible with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20910/?tab=description]1.6 update of Farm Cave Framework[/url], but doesn't have the dehydrator. This version will spawn the dehydrator (probably not on old saves already using the original Bats and Mushrooms mod, but on new saves when choosing that option).

The dehydrator is not pictured above because I don't want to go through the process of collecting images when the original mod page already has images.
